no_adcom_quote.quote: The Division determined that an Advisory Committee was not needed to review this application because this drug is not the first in its class, the clinical study design for the contraception indication was acceptable, the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues, the application did not raise significant public health questions and outside expertise was not necessary.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for Natazia (NDA022252). The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, the Office/Division Director memo, and the Medical Review all state that the Division determined an Advisory Committee was not needed because the drug is not first-in-class, the clinical study design was acceptable, no significant safety/efficacy or public health questions were raised, and there was extensive European marketing experience with estradiol valerate/dienogest. Because no committee was held, there are no AdCom-driven linkages to the approval.
